body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News & Press Release> The shock, dust and water-resistant ‘Casio G’zOne Type-S’ phone was unveiled at CES 2008. It is now available in three stylish colors including matte black, burgundy and the original classic navy.

Built to survive extreme environments the Casio G’zOne is tested to resist shocks, scratches, humidity, dust, vibration, salt fog and solar radiation. In addition the G’zOne is water resistant to a depth of one meter for up to half an hour.

The Type-S also includes Bluetooth capability for a safe, total hands-free communication experience as well as GPS, speakerphone, a built-in camera (for business-to-business use, the black and burgundy models are also available with the camera function disabled) and a handy, bright lantern.
Currently the matte black G’zOne is available exclusively online at Verizon and the burgundy is sold exclusively at Circuit City.
True to Casio’s legacy of innovation and user-friendliness, the G’zOne models are reliable and easy to use, elevating the new standards of communication.
